# Number formatting — ENGLISH locale (comma thousands, point decimal),
# consistent with the English UI. Vectorised for plotly formulas.
de_num <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  out <- format(round(x, digits), big.mark = ",", decimal.mark = ".",
                nsmall = digits, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  out[is.na(x)] <- "–"
  out
}
de_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  out <- paste0(de_num(x, digits), " %")
  out[is.na(x)] <- "–"
  out
}

# Einheit-Helper: AccRate immer als /100 Mio km/mi (international üblich)
KM_PER_MILE <- 1.609344
disp_rate <- function(rate_per_mio_km, unit = "km", digits = 3) {
  factor <- if (unit == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100
  unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " /100 Mio mi" else " /100 Mio km"
  out <- paste0(de_num(rate_per_mio_km * factor, digits), unit_str)
  out[is.na(rate_per_mio_km)] <- "–"
  out
}
disp_rate_val <- function(rate_per_mio_km, unit = "km", digits = 3) {
  factor <- if (unit == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100
  out <- de_num(rate_per_mio_km * factor, digits)
  out[is.na(rate_per_mio_km)] <- "–"
  out
}
disp_vtm <- function(vtm_mio_km, unit = "km") {
  factor <- if (unit == "mi") 1 / KM_PER_MILE else 1
  unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " Mio mi" else " Mio km"
  out <- paste0(de_num(vtm_mio_km * factor, 0), unit_str)
  out[is.na(vtm_mio_km)] <- "–"
  out
}
disp_dist <- function(km, unit = "km") {
  factor <- if (unit == "mi") 1 / KM_PER_MILE else 1
  unit_str <- if (unit == "mi") " mi" else " km"
  out <- paste0(de_num(km * factor, 0), unit_str)
  out[is.na(km)] <- "–"
  out
}

  if (unit == "mi") "/100 Mio mi" else "/100 Mio km"

# Running inside webR/shinylive (browser WASM)? Then data files are NOT in

# the deployed app and cached locally in the session.
IS_WASM <- identical(Sys.info()[["sysname"]], "Emscripten")

  BASE <- "data"

} else {
  BASE <- file.path(dirname(normalizePath("app.R")), "data")
}

# Resolve a data file: local path natively; HTTP fetch-and-cache under WASM.
data_path <- function(fname) {
  fp <- file.path(BASE, fname)
  if (!IS_WASM || file.exists(fp)) return(fp)
  # "../../data/" first: the webR worker resolves relative URLs against
  # its own location (/shinylive/webr/), so this one hits immediately.
  for (prefix in c("../../data/", "data/", "./data/", "../data/")) {
    ok <- tryCatch({
      utils::download.file(paste0(prefix, fname), fp,
                           quiet = TRUE, mode = "wb")
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) FALSE, warning = function(w) FALSE)
    if (ok && file.exists(fp) && file.size(fp) > 0) return(fp)
    if (file.exists(fp)) unlink(fp)   # remove failed partial download
  }
  stop("Could not fetch data file: ", fname)
}

# ── VTM-Berechnung ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Modus 1: Proportional (nach Länge, gesamt-VTM als Basis)
# Modus 2: BASt DTV-Gewichte (je Gruppe normiert auf Gruppen-Gesamtlänge)
# Modus 3: Eigene VTM-Anteile in % (normiert auf 100%)
calc_vtm <- function(roads_df, vtm_df, jahr, modus,
                     hw_pct     = 32,
                     nourban_pct = 27,
                     urban_pct  = 36,
                     unclass_pct = 5,
                     use_case   = "all",
                     source     = "kba") {
  vtm_year  <- vtm_df %>% filter(Jahr == jahr)
  total_vtm <- sum(vtm_year$VTM_Mrd_km) * 1000  # Mio km

  # Modus 3: normierte Prozente → Gruppen-VTM
  total_pct  <- hw_pct + nourban_pct + urban_pct + unclass_pct
  if (total_pct <= 0) total_pct <- 100
  m3_vtm <- tibble(
    Highway_Gruppe = c("Highway","Non-Urban","Urban","Unclassified"),
    VTM_m3         = c(hw_pct, nourban_pct, urban_pct, unclass_pct) /
                       total_pct * total_vtm
  )

  rv <- roads_df %>%
    left_join(vtm_year, by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
    left_join(m3_vtm,   by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
    mutate(
      group_length_m = GROUP_LENGTHS[Highway_Gruppe],
      VTM_final = case_when(
        modus == 1 ~
          (length_calc / TOTAL_NETWORK_M) * total_vtm,
        modus == 2 ~
          if_else(!is.na(VTM_Mrd_km) & group_length_m > 0,
            (length_calc / group_length_m) * (VTM_Mrd_km * 1000),
            (length_calc / TOTAL_NETWORK_M) * total_vtm),
        modus == 3 ~
          if_else(!is.na(VTM_m3) & group_length_m > 0,
            (length_calc / group_length_m) * VTM_m3,
            (length_calc / TOTAL_NETWORK_M) * total_vtm),
        TRUE ~ 0
      )
    )

  # Use-Case-Skalierung: VTM mit Fahrzeug-Anteil je Highway-Gruppe multiplizieren
  if (!is.null(use_case) && use_case != "all") {
    shares_dict <- get_vehicle_shares(source)
    if (use_case %in% names(shares_dict)) {
      shares <- shares_dict[[use_case]]$shares
      rv <- rv %>%
        mutate(uc_share = shares[Highway_Gruppe],
               uc_share = if_else(is.na(uc_share), 1, uc_share),
               VTM_final = VTM_final * uc_share)
    }
  }
  rv
}

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Native: per-segment lookup for joining accidents to road attributes.
  # WASM: attributes are already joined onto the accidents (prepare_web.R).
  roads_slim <- if (IS_WASM) NULL else roads %>%
    select(osm_id, Highway_Gruppe, length_calc, maxspeed, surface)

  acc_with_roads <- function(d) {
    if (IS_WASM) d else dplyr::left_join(d, roads_slim, by = "osm_id")
  }

  # ── Click filters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  FILT_KEYS   <- c("hwy","kat","art","typ","licht","strasse","wt","mon","stunde",
                   "maxspeed","surface","beteiligte")
  FILT_LABELS <- c("Road type","Severity","Accident type","Accident class",
                   "Light","Road state","Weekday","Month","Hour",
                   "Max speed","Surface","Involvement")

  kf <- reactiveValues(
    hwy = NULL, kat = NULL, art = NULL, typ = NULL, licht = NULL,
    strasse = NULL, wt = NULL, mon = NULL, stunde = NULL,
    maxspeed = NULL, surface = NULL, beteiligte = NULL
  )

  reset_kf <- function() {
    for (k in FILT_KEYS) kf[[k]] <- NULL
  }

  toggle_kf <- function(key, val) {
    if (!is.null(kf[[key]]) && kf[[key]] == val) kf[[key]] <- NULL
    else kf[[key]] <- val
  }

  # Sidebar-Filter-Änderung setzt Klick-Filter zurück
  observeEvent(list(input$year, input$region_global), { reset_kf() },
               ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$reset_kf, { reset_kf() })

  output$klickfilter_ui <- renderUI({
    active <- Filter(function(k) !is.null(kf[[k]]), FILT_KEYS)
    if (length(active) == 0) {
      # Hinweis-Banner statt leerer Bereich
      return(fluidRow(column(12,
        div(style = paste0("padding: 10px 22px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);",
                            "backdrop-filter: blur(12px);",
                            "border-radius: 9999px; margin: 0 0 12px;",
                            "box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(0,43,102,0.10);",
                            "border: 1px solid rgba(255,204,0,0.55);"),
          tags$i(class = "fa fa-mouse-pointer",
                 style = "color: #003399; margin-right: 8px;"),
          span(style = "font-family: Baskervville, serif; font-weight: 800;
                         color: #002b66; font-size: 14px;",
            "Tip: "),
          span(style = "color: #444; font-size: 13px;",
            "Click on a chart segment, bar or data point to filter. ",
            "Active filters appear here."))
      )))
    }
    chips <- lapply(active, function(k) {
      lbl <- FILT_LABELS[match(k, FILT_KEYS)]
      span(class = "kf-chip",
        span(class = "kf-chip-label", paste0(lbl, ":")),
        as.character(kf[[k]]),
        actionLink(paste0("kf_rm_", k), "×",
                   class = "kf-chip-x",
                   style = paste0("color: white; margin-left: 8px;",
                                   "font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;",
                                   "text-decoration: none; padding: 0 4px;",
                                   "border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer;"))
      )
    })
    fluidRow(column(12,
      div(style = "padding: 8px 22px 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
                   backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-radius: 9999px;

    # (statt Roads direkt zu filtern — sonst zu starker Bias durch

    r <- roads
    if (!is.null(kf$hwy))      r <- filter(r, Highway_Gruppe == kf$hwy)
    if (!is.null(kf$maxspeed)) r <- filter(r, maxspeed       == kf$maxspeed)
    if (!is.null(kf$surface))  r <- filter(r, surface        == kf$surface)

    rv <- calc_vtm(

      input$hw_pct, input$nourban_pct, input$urban_pct, input$unclass_pct,
      use_case = input$use_case %||% "all",
      source = input$vtm_source %||% "kba"
    )

    # Bundesland-Skalierung der VTM (proportional zur Acc-Anteils, je Highway-Gruppe)
    ul <- current_uland()
    if (!is.null(ul)) {
      yr <- as.integer(input$year)
      # Anteil der Unfälle dieses Bundeslands je Highway-Gruppe

        filter(Jahr == yr) %>%
        acc_with_roads() %>%
        filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>%
        group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
        summarise(de = n(),
                   bl = sum(ULAND == ul, na.rm = TRUE),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
        mutate(share = if_else(de > 0, bl / de, 0))
      rv <- rv %>%
        left_join(shares %>% select(Highway_Gruppe, share),
                   by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
        mutate(share = if_else(is.na(share), 0, share),
               VTM_final = VTM_final * share)

  # Raw value of a series
  trend_value <- function(df, key) {
    switch(key,

      injury  = df$injury_acc,

      fatal   = df$fatalities,
      injured = df$injured,

  # Value in the selected display mode (index / abs / rate)
  trend_disp_value <- function(df, key, mode, f) {
    v <- trend_value(df, key)
    if (mode == "index") {
      v / v[df$Jahr == min(df$Jahr)] * 100
    } else if (mode == "rate") {
      if (key == "vtm") rep(NA_real_, length(v))
      else v / df$vtm_mio_km * f
    } else v
  }

  # Axis title / value formatting per display mode

  }
  trend_digits <- function(mode) if (mode == "abs") 0 else 1

  # Statistics for the selected series in the selected display mode
  trends_stats <- reactive({
    df   <- trends_df()
    mode <- input$trend_display %||% "index"
    key  <- input$trend_stat_series %||% "injury"
    u    <- input$unit_choice %||% "km"
    f    <- if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100

    df$val <- trend_disp_value(df, key, mode, f)
    stat_df <- df
    if (isTRUE(input$trend_excl_covid))
      stat_df <- stat_df %>% filter(!Jahr %in% c(2020L, 2021L))

    fit <- lm(val ~ Jahr, data = stat_df)
    m <- mean(stat_df$val); s <- sd(stat_df$val)
    latest <- df %>% filter(Jahr == max(Jahr))
    list(
      key = key, mode = mode,
      mean = m, sd = s, lo = m - 2 * s, hi = m + 2 * s,
      slope = unname(coef(fit)[2]), r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      n = nrow(stat_df),
      latest_year = latest$Jahr,
      latest_val  = latest$val,
      latest_z    = if (s > 0) (latest$val - m) / s else NA_real_,
      fit = fit
    )
  })

  # ── Donut-Hilfsfunktion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Klicks werden via htmlwidgets::onRender → Shiny.setInputValue verkabelt.
  # Das ist robuster als event_data für Pies.
  # Feste Pie-Domain (obere ~62%) + Legende unten — alle Donuts gleich groß.
  make_donut <- function(labels, values, colors = PIE_PALETTE, src = NULL,
                         active_label = NULL) {
    n_total <- sum(values)
    seg_colors <- colors[seq_along(labels)]
    if (!is.null(active_label)) {
      for (i in seq_along(seg_colors)) {
        if (labels[i] != active_label) {
          seg_colors[i] <- adjustcolor(seg_colors[i], alpha.f = 0.30)
        }
      }
    }
    # Feste Pie-Domain (obere ~58%), Legende fest unten — alle Donuts gleich groß
    p <- plot_ly(
      labels    = labels,
      values    = values,
      type      = "pie",
      hole      = 0.55,
      source    = src,
      marker    = list(colors = seg_colors,
                       line   = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
      textinfo  = "percent",
      textfont  = list(size = 10, color = "white"),
      hoverinfo = "label+value+percent",
      direction = "clockwise",
      sort      = FALSE,
      domain    = list(x = c(0.05, 0.95), y = c(0.42, 1.00))
    ) %>%
      layout(
        annotations = list(list(
          text  = paste0("<b>", de_num(n_total, 0), "</b>"),
          x = 0.5, y = 0.72, showarrow = FALSE,
          font  = list(size = 13, color = "#002b66",
                       family = "Baskervville, serif"),
          xref  = "paper", yref = "paper"
        )),
        showlegend = TRUE,
        legend     = list(orientation = "h",
                          x = 0.5, y = 0.35,
                          xanchor = "center", yanchor = "top",
                          font = list(size = 8, family = "Arial"),
                          tracegroupgap = 2,
                          itemclick = FALSE, itemdoubleclick = FALSE),
        margin = list(t = 5, b = 5, l = 5, r = 5),
        plot_bgcolor  = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
        paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

    # Eigener Click-Handler via JS — stabiler als event_data für Pies
    if (!is.null(src)) {
      js <- sprintf("
        function(el) {
          el.on('plotly_click', function(d) {
            if (d && d.points && d.points.length > 0) {
              Shiny.setInputValue('donut_click_%s', {
                label: d.points[0].label,
                ts: new Date().getTime()
              }, {priority: 'event'});
            }
          });
        }", src)
      p <- p %>% htmlwidgets::onRender(js)
    }
    p
  }

  # Prüfen ob ein Unfall-Datensatz dem ODD entspricht (für Highlight)
  odd_filter_acc <- function(d) {
    if (!is.null(input$map_hwy) && length(input$map_hwy) < 4) {
      d <- d %>% filter(Highway_Gruppe %in% input$map_hwy)
    }
    if (!is.null(input$tageszeit) && length(input$tageszeit) < 3) {

  # Karten-gefilterte Unfälle (eigenständig, NICHT von Dashboard-Filtern abhängig)
  acc_map <- reactive({
    d <- acc_all %>%
      filter(Jahr == as.integer(input$year)) %>%
      acc_with_roads()
    d <- odd_filter_acc(d)
    # Bbox / ULAND
    bb <- map_bbox()
    if (!is.null(bb)) {
      if (!is.null(bb$uland)) {
        d <- d %>% filter(ULAND == bb$uland)
      } else {
        d <- d %>% filter(lon >= bb$xmin, lon <= bb$xmax,
                           lat >= bb$ymin, lat <= bb$ymax)
      }
    }
    # Maxspeed/Lanes-Filter — wirkt über osm_id-Verknüpfung
    if (IS_WASM) {
      # Attributes joined onto accidents — filter directly (same semantics
      # as the native osm_id membership filter below)
      if (!is.null(input$speed_range)) {
        d <- d %>% filter(is.na(maxspeed_kmh) |
                           (maxspeed_kmh >= input$speed_range[1] &
                            maxspeed_kmh <= input$speed_range[2]))

      if (!is.null(input$lanes_range)) {
        d <- d %>% filter(is.na(lanes_num) |
                           (lanes_num >= input$lanes_range[1] &
                            lanes_num <= input$lanes_range[2]))

  roads_map_basic <- reactive({
    r <- roads
    if (!is.null(input$map_hwy) && length(input$map_hwy) < 4) {
      r <- r %>% filter(Highway_Gruppe %in% input$map_hwy)
    }
    if (!is.null(input$speed_range) && "maxspeed_kmh" %in% names(r)) {
      r <- r %>% filter(is.na(maxspeed_kmh) |
                         (maxspeed_kmh >= input$speed_range[1] &
                          maxspeed_kmh <= input$speed_range[2]))
    }

                         (lanes_num >= input$lanes_range[1] &
                          lanes_num <= input$lanes_range[2]))
    }
    r

  # ODD-roads mit VTM (Region/Bbox-respektierend für Auswertung)
  # Lazy centroid index for true spatial network filtering (all segments,
  # not just those with accidents — avoids survivorship bias in the rate)
  roads_centroids <- reactive({
    if (IS_WASM) return(NULL)   # web uses the grid aggregate instead
    fp <- tryCatch(data_path("roads_centroids.rds"),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fp) || !file.exists(fp)) return(NULL)
    readRDS(fp)
  })

  roads_map <- reactive({
    r <- roads_map_basic()
    bb <- map_bbox()

    if (!is.null(bb) && is.null(bb$uland)) {
      if (IS_WASM) {
        # Web: bbox network from the 0.05° grid aggregate (approximation)
        grid <- web_grid()
        if (!is.null(grid)) {
          cells <- grid %>%
            filter(gx >= floor(bb$xmin / GRID_CELL),
                   gx <= floor(bb$xmax / GRID_CELL),
                   gy >= floor(bb$ymin / GRID_CELL),
                   gy <= floor(bb$ymax / GRID_CELL))
          if (!is.null(input$map_hwy) && length(input$map_hwy) < 4)
            cells <- cells %>% filter(Highway_Gruppe %in% input$map_hwy)
          sr <- input$speed_range %||% c(0, 130)
          keep_s <- c("na",
                      if (sr[1] <= 50)               "s50",
                      if (sr[1] <= 99 && sr[2] > 50) "s99",
                      if (sr[2] >= 100)              "s100")
          lr <- input$lanes_range %||% c(1, 6)
          keep_l <- c("na",
                      if (lr[1] <= 2) "l2",
                      if (lr[2] >= 3) "l3")
          r <- cells %>%
            filter(speed3 %in% keep_s, lanes2 %in% keep_l) %>%
            group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
            summarise(length_calc = sum(length_calc, na.rm = TRUE),
                      lit_no_m = sum(lit_no_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                      ow_m     = sum(ow_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                      br_m     = sum(br_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                      tu_m     = sum(tu_m, na.rm = TRUE),
                      rb_n     = sum(rb_n, na.rm = TRUE),
                      .groups = "drop")
        } else {
          r <- r[0, ]
        }
      } else {
        # Native: keep ALL segments whose centroid lies inside the rectangle
        cent <- roads_centroids()
        if (!is.null(cent)) {
          ids <- cent$osm_id[cent$c_lon >= bb$xmin & cent$c_lon <= bb$xmax &
                             cent$c_lat >= bb$ymin & cent$c_lat <= bb$ymax]
          r <- r %>% filter(osm_id %in% ids)
        } else {
          showNotification(
            "Centroid index missing (data/roads_centroids.rds) — network and rate for drawn areas unavailable.",
            type = "warning", duration = 6)
          r <- r[0, ]
        }
      }
    }

    rv <- calc_vtm(r, vtm_raw, as.integer(input$year), as.integer(input$modus),
             input$hw_pct, input$nourban_pct, input$urban_pct, input$unclass_pct,
             use_case = input$use_case %||% "all",
             source = input$vtm_source %||% "kba")

    if (!is.null(bb) && !is.null(bb$uland)) {
      # Federal state: scale mileage AND length by the state's accident
      # share per road group (same approximation as the dashboard —
      # true per-state network/mileage data is not published)
      yr <- as.integer(input$year)
      shares <- acc_all %>%
        filter(Jahr == yr) %>%
        acc_with_roads() %>%
        filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>%
        group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
        summarise(de = n(),
                  bl = sum(ULAND == bb$uland, na.rm = TRUE),
                  .groups = "drop") %>%
        mutate(share = if_else(de > 0, bl / de, 0))
      rv <- rv %>%
        left_join(shares %>% select(Highway_Gruppe, share),
                  by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
        mutate(share       = if_else(is.na(share), 0, share),
               VTM_final   = VTM_final * share,
               length_calc = length_calc * share) %>%
        mutate(across(any_of(c("lit_no_m","ow_m","br_m","tu_m","rb_n")),
                      ~ .x * share))
    }
    rv
  })

  output$odd_attr_stats <- renderUI({
    r <- roads_map()

    is_yes <- function(x) tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("yes","true","1")

      tu_km <- sum(r$tu_m, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000
      un_km <- sum(r$lit_no_m, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000

  # Karten-Inhalt aktualisieren je nach Modus
  observe({
    df <- acc_map()
    req(nrow(df) > 0, !is.null(df$lon))
    proxy <- leafletProxy("karte", data = df) %>%
      clearMarkers() %>% clearShapes() %>% clearControls() %>%

                  }),
                  title = "Severity", opacity = 0.8)

    } else if (input$map_modus == "roads") {
      # Roads mode: show ALL roads within the bbox.
      # ODD filter is not excluding but selective: ODD-matching roads
      # are coloured (with accidents = yellow–red, without = green),
      # non-matching = grey (context).
      geom <- roads_geom()
      if (is.null(geom)) {
        showNotification("Road geometries missing — run preprocess.R.",
                         type = "warning")
        return()
      }
      bb <- map_bbox()
      if (is.null(bb) || !is.null(bb$uland)) {
        showNotification(
          "Please draw a rectangle on the map to colour roads.",
          type = "message", duration = 5)
        return()
      }
      # Bbox filter via precomputed centroid index (fast); fallback: on-the-fly
      cent <- roads_centroids()
      if (!is.null(cent)) {
        ids_in <- cent$osm_id[cent$c_lon >= bb$xmin & cent$c_lon <= bb$xmax &
                              cent$c_lat >= bb$ymin & cent$c_lat <= bb$ymax]
        geom_sub <- geom %>% filter(osm_id %in% ids_in)
      } else {
        coords_c <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(geom)))
        in_bbox <- coords_c[, 1] >= bb$xmin & coords_c[, 1] <= bb$xmax &
                   coords_c[, 2] >= bb$ymin & coords_c[, 2] <= bb$ymax
        geom_sub <- geom[in_bbox, ]
      }
      if (nrow(geom_sub) == 0) {
        showNotification("No roads in the selected area.", type = "warning")
        return()
      }
      # Unfall-Anzahl je osm_id (ODD-gefiltert!)
      acc_seg <- df %>% count(osm_id, name = "n_acc")
      # Welche osm_ids matchen ODD? (anhand roads_map_basic = ODD-gefilterte Roads)
      odd_ids <- roads_map_basic()$osm_id
      # Alle Roads (komplett, auch nicht-ODD) für Kontext
      r_all <- roads %>%
        select(osm_id, Highway_Gruppe, length_calc, maxspeed, surface) %>%
        filter(osm_id %in% geom_sub$osm_id)
      r_attr <- calc_vtm(r_all, vtm_raw, as.integer(input$year),
                         as.integer(input$modus),
                         input$hw_pct, input$nourban_pct,
                         input$urban_pct, input$unclass_pct,
                         use_case = input$use_case %||% "all",
             source = input$vtm_source %||% "kba") %>%
        select(osm_id, length_calc, VTM_final) %>%
        left_join(acc_seg, by = "osm_id") %>%
        mutate(n_acc   = if_else(is.na(n_acc), 0L, n_acc),
               in_odd  = osm_id %in% odd_ids,
               AccRate = if_else(VTM_final > 0,
                                  n_acc / VTM_final, NA_real_))
      geom_join <- geom_sub %>%
        left_join(r_attr, by = "osm_id")

      # 3 Gruppen für Visualisierung:
      # - non_odd: nicht zur ODD gehörig → grau (Kontext)
      # - no_acc:  ODD + 0 Unfälle → grün
      # - with_acc: ODD + Unfälle → farbig (gelb–rot)
      non_odd  <- geom_join %>% filter(!in_odd)
      no_acc   <- geom_join %>% filter(in_odd, n_acc == 0)
      with_acc <- geom_join %>% filter(in_odd, n_acc > 0, !is.na(AccRate))

      proxy_layer <- proxy
      # 1) Roads outside ODD as context (grey)
      if (nrow(non_odd) > 0) {
        proxy_layer <- proxy_layer %>%
          addPolylines(
            data    = non_odd,
            color   = "#aaaaaa",
            weight  = 1.5, opacity = 0.4,
            group   = "acc_layer",
            popup   = ~paste0("<b>osm_id:</b> ", osm_id,
                              "<br><i>Outside ODD selection</i>")
          )
      }
      # 2) ODD roads without accidents (green = safe)
      if (nrow(no_acc) > 0) {
        proxy_layer <- proxy_layer %>%
          addPolylines(
            data    = no_acc,
            color   = "#4caf50",
            weight  = 3, opacity = 0.85,
            group   = "acc_layer",
            popup   = ~paste0("<b>osm_id:</b> ", osm_id,
                              "<br><i>0 accidents within ODD</i>")
          )
      }
      if (nrow(with_acc) > 0) {
        # Quantile clipping → robust colour scale
        q95 <- stats::quantile(with_acc$AccRate, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
        q05 <- stats::quantile(with_acc$AccRate, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
        q05 <- max(q05, 0)
        if (q95 <= q05) q95 <- q05 + 0.001
        with_acc$AccRate_clip <- pmin(pmax(with_acc$AccRate, q05), q95)
        # Scale: yellow → orange → red (accidents = at least yellow)
        pal <- colorNumeric(
          palette = c("#ffcc00","#ff9900","#cc3333"),
          domain  = c(q05, q95)
        )
        proxy_layer <- proxy_layer %>%
          addPolylines(
            data    = with_acc,
            color   = ~pal(AccRate_clip),
            weight  = 4, opacity = 0.95,
            group   = "acc_layer",
            popup   = ~paste0("<b>osm_id:</b> ", osm_id,
                              "<br><b>Accidents:</b> ", n_acc,
                              "<br><b>Mileage:</b> ", round(VTM_final, 4),
                              " Mio km<br><b>AccRate:</b> ", round(AccRate, 3),
                              " /Mio km")
          ) %>%
          addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal,
                    values = seq(q05, q95, length.out = 50),
                    title  = paste0("AccRate<br>[acc./Mio km]<br>",
                                    "<small>5–95 % quantile</small>"),
                    opacity = 0.8)
      }
      # ── Zusätzliche Markierungen (gelb hinterlegt) ─────────────────────
      hl <- input$highlight_attrs %||% character(0)
      if (length(hl) > 0) {
        # Voll-Roads für Attribut-Lookup (nur osm_ids im Bbox)
        attr_lookup <- roads %>%
          filter(osm_id %in% geom_sub$osm_id) %>%
          select(any_of(c("osm_id","bridge","tunnel","junction",
                          "lit","oneway","surface")))
        is_yes <- function(x) {
          if (is.null(x)) return(rep(FALSE, length(geom_sub$osm_id)))
          tolower(as.character(x)) %in% c("yes","true","1")
        }
        hl_match <- function(col) {
          if (!col %in% names(attr_lookup)) return(rep(FALSE, nrow(attr_lookup)))
          v <- attr_lookup[[col]]
          if (col == "junction") {
            tolower(as.character(v)) %in% c("roundabout","circular")
          } else if (col == "lit") {
            tolower(as.character(v)) %in% c("no")
          } else if (col == "surface") {
            tolower(as.character(v)) %in%
              c("cobblestone","sett","gravel","compacted","unpaved",
                "fine_gravel","ground","dirt","sand","grass","earth")
          } else {
            is_yes(v)
          }
        }
        hl_specs <- list(
          bridge      = list(check = "bridge",   label = "Bridge"),
          tunnel      = list(check = "tunnel",   label = "Tunnel"),
          roundabout  = list(check = "junction", label = "Roundabout"),
          no_lit      = list(check = "lit",      label = "Unlit"),
          bad_surface = list(check = "surface",  label = "Poor surface"),
          oneway      = list(check = "oneway",   label = "One-way street")
        )
        for (key in hl) {
          spec <- hl_specs[[key]]
          if (is.null(spec)) next
          mask <- hl_match(spec$check)
          ids  <- attr_lookup$osm_id[mask]
          geom_hl <- geom_sub %>% filter(osm_id %in% ids)
          if (nrow(geom_hl) > 0) {
            proxy_layer <- proxy_layer %>%
              addPolylines(
                data    = geom_hl,
                color   = "#003399",
                weight  = 8, opacity = 0.45,
                group   = "highlight_layer",
                popup   = ~paste0("<b>", spec$label, "</b><br>",
                                  "osm_id: ", osm_id)
              )
          }
        }
      }

      # Custom legend for the categories (always shown)
      legend_html <- paste0(
        "<div style='background:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px;",
        "box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); font-size:12px;",
        "font-family:Arial; line-height:1.6;'>",
        "<b style='color:#002b66;'>Road categories</b><br>",
        "<span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:3px;",
        "background:#4caf50; vertical-align:middle;'></span> ",
        "ODD without accident<br>",
        "<span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:3px;",
        "background:linear-gradient(to right,#ffcc00,#ff9900,#cc3333);",
        "vertical-align:middle;'></span> ODD with accidents<br>",
        "<span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:3px;",
        "background:#aaa; vertical-align:middle;'></span> ",
        "Outside ODD"
      )
      if (length(hl) > 0) {
        legend_html <- paste0(legend_html,
          "<br><span style='display:inline-block; width:12px; height:5px;",
          "background:#003399; opacity:0.5; vertical-align:middle;'></span> ",
          "Highlighted attributes")
      }
      legend_html <- paste0(legend_html, "</div>")
      proxy_layer %>%
        addControl(html = legend_html, position = "topright")
    }
  })

  # ── Unfallrate nach Gruppe ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$chart_accrate_gruppe <- renderPlotly({
    roads_g <- roads_vtm() %>%
      filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>%
      group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
      summarise(VTM_sum = sum(VTM_final, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

    acc_g <- acc_joined() %>%
      filter(!is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>%
      group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
      summarise(n_acc = n(), .groups = "drop")

    df <- roads_g %>%
      left_join(acc_g, by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
      mutate(n_acc   = if_else(is.na(n_acc), 0L, n_acc),
             AccRate = if_else(VTM_sum > 0, n_acc / VTM_sum, NA_real_)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(AccRate))

    req(nrow(df) > 0)

    farben <- vapply(df$Highway_Gruppe, function(g) FARBEN[g],
                     character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

    u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km"
    factor <- if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100
    df$AccRate_disp <- df$AccRate * factor
    ref_disp <- 0.4 * factor
    avg_curr <- if (sum(df$VTM_sum) > 0)
      sum(df$n_acc) / sum(df$VTM_sum) * factor else NA_real_
    plot_ly(df, x = ~Highway_Gruppe, y = ~AccRate_disp, type = "bar",
            marker = list(color = farben,
                          line = list(color = COL_DARK, width = 0.5))) %>%
      layout(
        xaxis  = list(title = ""),
        yaxis  = list(title = paste0("Accidents ", unit_label_rate(u))),
        shapes = list(
          # BASt-Referenz (DE-weit)
          list(type = "line", x0 = -0.5, x1 = nrow(df) - 0.5,
               y0 = ref_disp, y1 = ref_disp,
               line = list(color = "#888", dash = "dot", width = 1.5)),
          # Aktueller Durchschnitt der Auswahl
          list(type = "line", x0 = -0.5, x1 = nrow(df) - 0.5,
               y0 = avg_curr, y1 = avg_curr,
               line = list(color = "#003399", dash = "dash", width = 2))
        ),
        annotations = list(
          list(x = nrow(df) - 1, y = ref_disp, xanchor = "right",
               text = paste0("BASt-Ref. ", de_num(ref_disp, 1)),
               showarrow = FALSE, yshift = 10,
               font = list(size = 10, color = "#666"),
               bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)"),
          list(x = 0, y = avg_curr, xanchor = "left",
               text = paste0("Selection ø ", de_num(avg_curr, 1)),
               showarrow = FALSE, yshift = 10,
               font = list(size = 10, color = "#003399"),
               bgcolor = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)")
        ),
        showlegend = FALSE
      )
  })

  # ── Jahresvergleich ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$chart_accrate_jahr <- renderPlotly({
    ul <- current_uland()
    results <- lapply(c(2023L, 2024L), function(yr) {
      a <- acc_all %>% filter(Jahr == yr)
      if (!is.null(ul)) a <- a %>% filter(ULAND == ul)
      r_in <- roads
      if (!is.null(ul) && !IS_WASM)
        r_in <- r_in %>% filter(osm_id %in% unique(a$osm_id))
      r <- calc_vtm(r_in, vtm_raw, yr, as.integer(input$modus),
                    input$hw_pct, input$nourban_pct, input$urban_pct, input$unclass_pct,
                    use_case = input$use_case %||% "all",
             source = input$vtm_source %||% "kba")
      if (!is.null(ul) && IS_WASM) {
        # Web: scale VTM by the state's accident share per group
        sh <- acc_all %>% filter(Jahr == yr, !is.na(Highway_Gruppe)) %>%
          group_by(Highway_Gruppe) %>%
          summarise(de = n(), bl = sum(ULAND == ul, na.rm = TRUE),
                    .groups = "drop") %>%
          mutate(share = if_else(de > 0, bl / de, 0))
        r <- r %>%
          left_join(sh %>% select(Highway_Gruppe, share),
                    by = "Highway_Gruppe") %>%
          mutate(share = if_else(is.na(share), 0, share),
                 VTM_final = VTM_final * share)
      }
      vtm_s <- sum(r$VTM_final, na.rm = TRUE)
      tibble(Jahr = as.character(yr),
             AccRate = if (vtm_s > 0) nrow(a) / vtm_s else NA_real_)
    })
    df <- bind_rows(results)
    u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km"
    factor <- if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100
    df$AccRate_disp <- df$AccRate * factor
    plot_ly(df, x = ~Jahr, y = ~AccRate_disp, type = "bar",
            marker = list(color = c(COL_HIGHWAY, COL_NONURBAN),
                          line = list(color = COL_DARK, width = 0.5))) %>%
      layout(xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
             yaxis = list(title = paste0("Accidents ", unit_label_rate(u))),
             showlegend = FALSE)
  })

  # ── Plausibilitätstabelle ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  output$table_plausibilitaet <- renderTable({
    vtm_s <- sum(roads_vtm()$VTM_final, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_acc <- nrow(acc_joined())
    rate  <- if (vtm_s > 0) n_acc / vtm_s else NA_real_

    # Effektive Modus-3-Prozentwerte
    total_pct <- input$hw_pct + input$nourban_pct + input$urban_pct + input$unclass_pct
    if (total_pct <= 0) total_pct <- 100

    u <- input$unit_choice %||% "km"
    factor <- if (u == "mi") 100 * KM_PER_MILE else 100
    rate_disp <- if (!is.na(rate)) rate * factor else NA_real_
    ref_disp <- 0.4 * factor
    tibble(
      Kennzahl = c(
        "Accidents (filtered)",
        paste0("VTM sum [", if (u=="mi") "Mio mi" else "Mio km", "]"),
        paste0("AccRate [", unit_label_rate(u), "]"),
        paste0("BASt 2022 reference [", unit_label_rate(u), "]"),
        "Deviation",
        "Mode-3 Highway [%]",
        "Mode-3 Non-Urban [%]",
        "Mode-3 Urban [%]",
        "Mode-3 Unclassified [%]"
      ),
      Wert = c(
        de_num(n_acc, 0),
        de_num(if (u=="mi") vtm_s/KM_PER_MILE else vtm_s, 0),
        if (!is.na(rate_disp)) de_num(rate_disp, 3) else "–",
        de_num(ref_disp, 1),
        if (!is.na(rate)) de_pct((rate - 0.4) / 0.4 * 100, 1) else "–",
        de_pct(input$hw_pct     / total_pct * 100, 1),
        de_pct(input$nourban_pct/ total_pct * 100, 1),
        de_pct(input$urban_pct  / total_pct * 100, 1),
        de_pct(input$unclass_pct/ total_pct * 100, 1)
      )
    )
  })

  # ── Eigenes Szenario: Sidebar-Text-Vergleich ─────────────────────────────
  output$scenario_sidebar_compare <- renderUI({
    custom_n   <- max(input$custom_acc %||% 0, 0)
    custom_vtm <- max(input$custom_vtm %||% 0.0001, 0.0001)
    custom_rate <- custom_n / custom_vtm

    de_n   <- gesamt_acc()
    de_vtm <- gesamt_vtm()
    de_rate <- if (de_vtm > 0) de_n / de_vtm else NA_real_
    diff_pct <- if (!is.na(de_rate) && de_rate > 0)
      (custom_rate - de_rate) / de_rate * 100 else NA_real_

    eval_color <- if (!is.na(diff_pct)) {
      if (diff_pct < -10)  "#4caf50"  # deutlich besser → grün
      else if (diff_pct > 10) "#cc3333"  # deutlich schlechter → rot
      else "#ffcc00"  # ähnlich → gelb
    } else "#fff"

    eval_text <- if (!is.na(diff_pct)) {
      if (diff_pct < -10) "✓ Safer than DE"
      else if (diff_pct > 10) "✗ Riskier than DE"
      else "≈ Comparable to DE"
    } else "—"

    div(style = paste0("padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);",
                        "border-radius: 6px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px;"),
      div(style = "color: #ffcc00; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px;",
        "AccRate comparison"),
      div(style = "color: #fff; line-height: 1.6;",
        span(style = "color: #cfd8e8;", "Yours:"),
        " ",
        span(style = "color: #fff; font-weight: 700;",
             disp_rate(custom_rate, input$unit_choice %||% "km")),
        br(),
        span(style = "color: #cfd8e8;", paste0("DE ", input$year, ":")),
        " ",
        span(style = "color: #fff; font-weight: 700;",
             disp_rate(de_rate, input$unit_choice %||% "km")),
        br(),
        span(style = "color: #cfd8e8;", "Difference:"),
        " ",
        span(style = "color: #fff; font-weight: 700;",
             if (!is.na(diff_pct))
               paste0(if (diff_pct >= 0) "+" else "",
                      round(diff_pct, 1), " %")
             else "—")
      ),
      div(style = paste0("margin-top: 6px; padding: 4px 8px;",
                          "background:", eval_color, "; color: #002b66;",
                          "font-weight: 800; border-radius: 4px;",
                          "text-align: center; font-size: 11px;"),
        eval_text
      )
    )
  })

  # ── Matching-Distanz-Histogramm ──────────────────────────────────────────
}
